name: Taboom
ability: Each night, choose a character. The first player to name it publicly tomorrow might die at any time until dusk.
flavor: Speak of the Devil, and he shall appear.
firstNightReminder: Wake the Taboom, they choose a character. Put the Taboom to sleep. Mark the first player to mention that character with the Spoke Out reminder.
otherNightReminder: Remove the Spoke Out reminder token. Wake the Taboom, they choose a character. Put the Taboom to sleep. Mark the first player to mention that character with the Spoke Out reminder.
